get_models: fetch the list of supported models from the Open Catalyst Project API using the async Client class
get_bulks: fetch the list of supported bulk materials from the Open Catalyst Project API using the async Client class
get_adsorbates: fetch the list of supported adsorbates from the Open Catalyst Project API using the async Client class
submit_adsorbate_slab_relaxations: submit adsorbate slab relaxation jobs to the OCP API with a specified model and adsorbate configurations
get_adsorbate_slab_relaxations_results: fetch relaxation results for a given system ID from the OCP API with optional config and field filters
